mentions.note: One day I saw a Chinese-bound book peeking out from under the master's desk, and it was the Jin Ping Mei. I had read only Bakin's Kinpeibai, but I knew the Chinese edition of the Jin Ping Mei was very different, and I thought: this master is a man one can't let one's guard down around.*
